svg.title: Gradient descent on the cost surface
svg.desc: Contour map of the cost over the normalised intercept θ₀ and slope θ₁. The path starts at θ = (1, 1) and moves in a straight line, with steps getting shorter, to the minimum at θ = (0, 0.838).
svg.text: Gradient descent on the cost surface
normalised data makes the bowl round, so the path is straight
